title: Le Premier Souffle
caption: One instruction at a time, drawn in three breaths: fetch, execute, remember. No cache, no predictor.
register: C0 integer foundation: multicycle RV64I and FENCE.I core, terminal laboratory trap record, unified 64-bit memory bus, retirement trace, 16 KiB synchronous RAM wrapper. Called "revision 0" before versioning began.

title: Le Tampon
caption: The last beat fetched is kept, and the next instruction often finds it already there.
register: Fetch buffer: the last fetched 8-byte beat serves the next instruction when it is in the same beat, skipping FETCH. Cleared by reset, fence.i and stores to the beat. Dhrystone: 2,188.2 to 1,706.2 clocks per run.

title: La Bibliothèque
caption: A small library of instructions replaces the buffer: 4 KiB, direct-mapped, 8-byte lines.
register: Instruction cache replaces the fetch buffer: direct-mapped, ICACHE_BEATS 8-byte lines (default 512, 4 KiB), new parameter on rv64_core and rv64_bram_soc; same coherence rules. Dhrystone: 1,706.2 to 988.7 clocks per run.

title: L'Impatience
caption: Loads and stores send their request from EXECUTE instead of waiting a clock.
register: Loads and stores issue their bus request from EXECUTE; MEMORY holds the same request if needed. One clock less per data access with the synchronous RAM. Bus protocol unchanged.

title: L'Accusé
caption: The memory acknowledges a write in the clock it is offered; stores now retire at once.
register: RAM wrapper acknowledges writes in the clock they are presented; reads unchanged. Stores now retire from EXECUTE.
marks: writes acknowledged in the same clock

title: Le Miroir
caption: A data cache for loads, 4 KiB and write-through, answers what the bus used to.
register: Data cache for loads: direct-mapped, write-through, DCACHE_BEATS 8-byte lines (default 512, 4 KiB), new parameter on rv64_core and rv64_bram_soc. Loads that hit complete in EXECUTE with no bus request; all memory treated as cacheable.
breaking: No (new parameter; loads that hit no longer reach the bus)
marks: writes acknowledged in the same clock

title: L'Arithmétique
caption: The M extension arrives: multiply and a divider that steps once per clock.
register: M extension: mul, mulh, mulhsu, mulhu, div, divu, rem, remu and the w forms. Multiply completes in EXECUTE; divide-by-zero, signed overflow and small dividends complete in EXECUTE; other divides use a DIVIDE state, one step per clock from the quotient's highest possible bit. ISA string rv64im_zifencei.
units: M extension; divide one step per clock
marks: writes acknowledged in the same clock

title: Le Duo
caption: Two instructions in one clock: a second slot and a second retirement port.
register: Dual issue: the instruction after an integer operation, a data-cache-hit load or a store to another beat executes in the same clock when it is a simple integer operation in the same 8-byte beat, independent of the first. New second retirement port retire2_* on rv64_core and retire2_valid on rv64_bram_soc.
units: M extension; divide one step per clock
marks: writes acknowledged in the same clock

title: Le Pont
caption: The second slot may reach into the next beat, and may be a conditional branch.

units: M extension; divide one step per clock

title: Deux Lectures
caption: A second data-cache port lets an aligned load ride in the second slot.
